acceptance: Start from current origin/dev in a clean governed task worktree; supervisor and auto-worker are the only implementation path.

Reproduce and evidence the 2026-08-02 failure: authoritative task-state event log about 2.03GB with at least 8413 events; current guarded dispatcher dry-run times out at 30s and 60s before catalog admission while load_authoritative_task_state calls load_events and validates full historical states.

Make every guarded-dispatcher authoritative state read and post-materialization readback consume one consistent validated snapshot through the existing task-state store contract instead of materializing and revalidating the full event list.

Preserve SHA-256 journal-prefix verification, actual prefix-head binding, sequence/hash-chain/state_sha validation, shared/exclusive lock ordering, checkpoint-tail validation, immutable-catalog validation, deduplication, and all-or-nothing authoritative transaction semantics.

Fail closed for absent, stale, truncated, forged, internally valid but wrong-head, torn, unreadable, or mismatched checkpoints. Never accept checkpoint fields or mtime alone as authority; fallback full replay is allowed only when integrity requires it and must be explicit in evidence.

The product catalog remains byte-for-byte unchanged with exactly 28 unique tasks, G1=25, G2=2, G3=1, the existing BFF revalidation task and release-gate edge retained, and unique sink L12-VERIFY-LEARN-REAL-VERIFIER-001.

Add deterministic regressions for warm checkpoint plus empty tail, warm checkpoint plus appended tail, concurrent append, forced full replay equivalence, corrupt/truncated/forged checkpoint, hash or sequence mismatch, and pre-admission failure without partial task materialization.

Add a scale test or benchmark representing at least the current 2GB/8400-event workload without checking a giant fixture into git; capture elapsed phases, peak memory, checkpoint use, number of revalidated tail events, and prove the guarded dry-run completes under 30 seconds and reaches a catalog admission verdict.
Run focused dispatcher and task-state-store suites, the guarded-remediation catalog validator, py_compile, JSON evidence validation, git diff --check, and relevant supervisor regression.

No config edit, canonical event-log/checkpoint mutation, log truncation/rotation, manual state edit, provider policy change, worker kill, product-controller implementation, catalog task materialization, live service mutation, or deployment in this source task.

Keep unrelated runtime-generated files out. Evidence must identify current source SHA, exact benchmark input identity, before/after timings, integrity negatives, residual risks, and remain review_pending until independent exact-head approval.
Deliver a clean PR to dev with required Task-ID-prefixed commit and truthful trailers; wait for checks and Human/Ops exact-head review before merge.
Rollout is source merge followed by separately governed command-runtime promotion and live canary. Rollback is PR revert; no config migration or destructive journal operation.
